narratives.Overview:
# Exact-miss session:start hint deny names quoting/pipe/chain when those tokens are absent

Leftover of #4780 after blocking pain-audit 5735714377, retraction 5735725845, and Handoff 5735728750. Operator confirmed the leftover split on 2026-09-18. Do not ingest #4780 as double-dash uninspectable closed.

## Summary

The recorded #4780 target (deft session:start -- --read-only is uninspectable because of Directive own --) does not survive at dispatch-sha f33b8b8e. That four-token argv is exact. hintUninspectableLifecycleCommand is null. The occupancy-identity-unavailable copy that names quoting, redirect, pipe, or chain does not fire on that argv.

That copy fires when inspectExactLifecycleCommand is null and the hint still returns session:start: trailing/leading space, newline, CRLF, double space, tabs, true pipes, and a heredoc body that only mentions session:start. Agents then add --session-id=host:claude:v1:... by trial (#4708 namespace on the claude wire host).

Closed #4577 already reproduced the piped form plus heredoc compound issue-create. The surviving recut is false-cause hint deny on exact-miss, not making -- inspectable.

## Measured (dispatch-sha f33b8b8e24c9746d02f66532bd1815271771e969)

- packages/core/src/hooks/classify/host-session-identity.ts: inspectExactLifecycleCommand for deft session:start -- --read-only is verb session:start, requiresOwner false. Lone -- is an unknown forwarded arg so rewriteSafe is false; that is not the uninspectable class.
- packages/core/src/hooks/dispatcher.ts 2502-2556: hinted deny copy is occupancy-identity-unavailable quoting/redirect/pipe/chain.
- Tests lock deft session:start --read-only as exact. agents_md_session_start.test.ts locks deft session:start -- --read-only in agents-entry. commands.md uses deft session:start --read-only and task session:start -- --read-only.

## Desired shape

- When exact is null and the hint returns a lifecycle verb, deny text names the actual miss (whitespace, empty token, heredoc mention, pipe, chain). Do not blame quoting/redirect/pipe/chain when those tokens are absent.
- Keep fail-closed on true compound forms. Do not trim-then-rewrite a command whose newline hid a second segment.
- Keep rewriteSafe versus hint as separate classes. Do not bind -- as uninspectable. Four-token deft session:start -- --read-only stays exact.
- Tests: four-token argv exact; trailing space / heredoc mention hinted session:start with a deny copy that names the miss; piped form still deny.

## Out of scope

- Recutting -- as uninspectable (refuted on #4780).
- Dropping the chain/pipe/redirect fail-closed.
- Native grok UPDATED_INPUT_WIRE_HOSTS rewrite (native grok is outside that set; filed --session-id=host:claude:v1: is the claude wire host).

Related: #4780, #4577, #4431, #3914, #4708.

Refutation of Stop 1 comment 5736647218 at dispatch-sha 8b4be69db9dae571c72eb9dd8e2ebd49b601cf94.

The target does not survive intact. Horizontal-whitespace exact-miss plus hint does emit the quoting/pipe/chain occupancy-identity-unavailable copy. True compounds, heredoc mention as one class, and "that copy is why agents add --session-id=host:claude:v1 by trial" do not.

Method: pin-read `packages/core/src/hooks/classify/host-session-identity.ts` and `packages/core/src/hooks/dispatcher.ts` at that SHA; ran `decideHook` + `inspectExactLifecycleCommand` + `hintUninspectableLifecycleCommand` on the argv below; re-ran `dispatcher.test.ts` "uninspectable lifecycle identity rewrite" (16 passed).

## 1. True compounds are not false-cause

sharpens-framing

Evidence: `deft session:start --read-only | head` and `deft session:start && echo ok` are exact-null, hint `session:start`, deny `occupancy-identity-unavailable` with "(quoting, redirect, pipe, or chain)". Pipe and `&&` are present. `dispatcher.test.ts` locks the chained form and the matching `--session-id` allow. `exactLifecycleInvocation` comments that quoting, redirection, and chaining are the exact-null class.

Failure mode: calling that copy false-cause on true compounds recuts #4431 / #4577 fail-closed as if the parenthetical were a lie.

Disposition: keep fail-closed on pipe, redirect, newline, and chain. Name those as the actual miss. Do not put them in the false-cause leftover.

## 2. Heredoc mention is not one miss class

sharpens-framing

Evidence at this SHA:

- `cat <<EOF` then `please run deft session:start next` then `EOF` — hint null, allow. Mid-line mention is argument-position, same as `echo deft session:start`.
- `cat <<EOF` then `deft session:start` then `EOF` — hint `session:start`, deny with the stock copy. That is newline executable-position (#4431), not a mention.
- `cat <<'EOF' | gh issue create --body-file -` with a body line that mentions `deft session:start` — hint null, allow.

Failure mode: "heredoc mention" as a third false-cause exemplar either over-denies a newline compound or names a shape that does not fire.

Disposition: drop heredoc-mention as a distinct false-cause class, or split line-start newline (keep fail-closed) from mid-line mention (no hint).

## 3. The stock copy instructs --session-id; it is not a trial of host:claude:v1

sharpens-framing

Evidence: the hinted deny is one string: not inspectable (quoting, redirect, pipe, or chain). Re-run as a simple command with `--session-id=${named}`. On host `claude`, `named` is `host:claude:v1:c2Vzc2lvbi1h`. Trailing-space `--read-only` plus that owner allows. `dispatcher.test.ts` locks chained start plus matching owner as allow. Native host `grok` skips `attachLifecycleIdentityRewrite` (`UPDATED_INPUT_WIRE_HOSTS` is codex, claude, cursor): trailing space and pipe on grok allow with no copy. Host `claude` plus `GROK_HOOK_EVENT` names `--session-id=host:grok:v1:...`, not claude.

Failure mode: treating leftover success as "agents stop adding `--session-id=host:claude:v1` by trial" cannot be delivered by recutting the parenthetical. The next sentence still names the recovery the matching-id path honours. Issue Out of scope already parks native grok rewrite and the claude wire namespace.

Disposition: drop the trial conjunct from the target. P1 stays the false-cause parenthetical on misses that are not quoting/redirect/pipe/chain. Recut copy does not remove `--session-id=`.

## 4. Copy-only recut leaves --read-only whitespace as an owner deny

sharpens-framing

Evidence: `deft session:start --read-only` is exact, `requiresOwner` false, allow, no rewrite. The same argv with leading space, trailing space, double space, or tab is exact-null (`command !== command.trim()`, empty token from `split(" ")`, or `INSPECTABLE_TOKEN_PATTERN`), hint `session:start`, deny `occupancy-identity-unavailable` asking for `--session-id=host:claude:v1:...`. CRLF is different: the hint tokenizer emits a newline chain token.

Failure mode: agents following the copy bind occupancy identity onto a read-only alignment that the trimmed form does not require. A parenthetical recut still denies.

Disposition: name this remainder if the leftover stays copy-only. Do not trim-then-rewrite across newline.

## Injection / swarm lens

The target changes identity and untrusted shell text, and the deny string is an envelope agents execute.

Matching `--session-id` still allows hinted compounds, including whitespace and `&&`. That is the #4431 escape hatch. Copy recut does not close it. If deny text names the miss, use a closed class (whitespace | empty-token | newline | pipe | redirect | quote | chain). Do not splice command bytes into the envelope.

## Road not taken

Horizontal-only trim so `deft session:start --read-only ` stays exact / `requiresOwner` false. Rejected for this leftover because Desired shape keeps fail-closed and forbids trim-then-rewrite when a newline hid a second segment. Steelman of one stock copy: "re-run as a simple command" is the recovery for every exact-null hint, so a taxonomy is extra. What flips that: the whitespace `--read-only` form is already simple except whitespace, and the stock cause sends the agent to `--session-id` instead of deleting a space.

## What survives

On `UPDATED_INPUT_WIRE_HOSTS`, when `inspectExactLifecycleCommand` is null and the hint is `session:start` and quoting/redirect/pipe/chain tokens are absent, the `occupancy-identity-unavailable` copy still blames those tokens. Measured: leading/trailing space, double space, tab. Four-token `deft session:start -- --read-only` stays exact, `requiresOwner` false, hint null. Do not recut `--` as uninspectable.

## 2. Measured class is examples, not an exclusive leftover set

Trailing CR/LF is exact-null via `trim` and the hint tokenizer emits a `\n` chain token with no second segment. Bound-remedy item 2 already fail-closes newline. Item 1's When-clause already covers the tokens-absent set; the measured class lists ASCII space/tab only.

Failure mode: locking next-build tests to leading/trailing space, double space, and tab leaves those other tokens-absent misses on the stock parenthetical.

Disposition: keep item 1's When-clause as the leftover. Read the measured class as the cases re-run here, not a closed exclusive set. Does not retract `relieves: P1`. Does not change the harvested leftover if that When-clause stays the item.

Treat expansion / Unicode-trim misses as unrelieved P1 and block bind. Rejected because item 1's When-clause is the P1 leftover and is already on the harvest. What flips that: a later parser or AC that takes only the measured-class substring as the next-build set.
